description: Declared mutants of the render Module, render_world and sdl_gpu (batches R2a, r2b-2d and r2b-3d, v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-r2a, v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-r2b-2d and v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-r2b-3d; Design Invariants RD-1 to RD-9 in docs/architecture/target/v2/render.zh-Hant.md, SDL-4, SDL-5 and section 7 in sdl.zh-Hant.md; ids rd-, rw-, sg-, gp-, g3-, p2-, re-). The gp- mutants and the g3- mutants other than g3-abi- need a GPU (label gpu: a machine with one, or Lavapipe). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails with the expected message.
